---
name: "Bug report / 錯誤回報"
about: "Report a reproducible installation, MCP, or presentation problem / 回報可重現的問題"
title: "[Bug] "
---

> Do not attach private Markdown, images, PDFs, presentations, credentials, or logs containing personal paths. Use a small sanitized example. For a security vulnerability, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/junyi0111/MarpPPT/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead.
>
> 請勿附上私人 Markdown、圖片、PDF、簡報、憑證或含個人路徑的日誌；請改用已去識別的最小範例。安全漏洞請依 [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/junyi0111/MarpPPT/blob/main/SECURITY.md) 回報。

## Problem / 問題

Describe what failed and when it happened.

## Steps to reproduce / 重現步驟

1. [First action / 第一步]
2. [Next action / 下一步]
3. [Observed result / 觀察結果]

## Expected and actual result / 預期與實際結果

- Expected / 預期：
- Actual / 實際：
- Exact error message, if any / 錯誤訊息（如有）：

## Environment / 環境

- MarpPPT version or commit / 版本或提交：
- Installation method (Agent, desktop installer, manual) / 安裝方式：
- OS and CPU architecture / 作業系統與處理器：
- Agent host and version (for example, Codex desktop) / Agent 與版本：
- Node.js version, if known / Node.js 版本（如已知）：
- PowerPoint or preview tools, if relevant / PowerPoint 或預覽工具（如相關）：

## Sanitized evidence / 去識別後的證據

Paste the smallest relevant log excerpt or attach a synthetic example. If the problem concerns a PPTX repair prompt, include the prompt text and whether saving and reopening changed the result.
